title: Telegram Rich Messages Capability Matrix
description: Verified capability matrix for Telegram Rich Messages (Bot API 10.1+, June 2026). Base SHA: 8eb584e19f7ba7c8cb78f5b9121cb312ac13bd06

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message field in response; absence indicates fallback
capabilities.notes: Works for private chats, bots, supergroups, channels. Supports business_connection_id, message_thread_id, direct_messages_topic_id.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Returns True on success; ephemeral, no message structure proof
capabilities.notes: Must call sendRichMessage to persist final content. Direct upload of new files not supported.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Returns edited Message object with rich_message field if preserved
capabilities.fallback: Delete old message + send new rich message
capabilities.notes: No dedicated editRichMessage method. text and rich_message are mutually exclusive. For inline messages, cannot upload new files.

limits.mutually_exclusive_fields: Exactly one of html, markdown, or blocks must be used

capabilities.verification_strategy: N/A — input type
capabilities.notes: Fields: html (string), markdown (string), blocks (InputRichBlock[]), media (InputRichMessageMedia[]), is_rtl (boolean), skip_entity_detection (boolean)

limits.media_url_scheme: HTTP/HTTPS only (not tg:// in markdown mode)

capabilities.verification_strategy: N/A — formatting mode
capabilities.notes: Supports bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, spoiler, code, marked, headings, lists, task lists, blockquotes, tables, footnotes, math, media blocks. IMPORTANT LIMITATION: Markdown is NOT parsed inside HTML block tags except <blockquote>, <details>, and <aside>. Inside other HTML blocks only HTML tags can be used (no Markdown syntax).

limits.media_url_scheme: HTTP/HTTPS or tg:// with media array (Bot API 10.2+)

capabilities.verification_strategy: N/A — formatting mode
capabilities.notes: Supports all HTML tags plus custom Telegram tags: tg-math, tg-math-block, tg-collage, tg-slideshow, tg-map, tg-spoiler, tg-emoji, tg-time, tg-reference, tg-reference-link

capabilities.verification_strategy: N/A — input mode
capabilities.notes: Most verbose but type-safe. 21 InputRichBlock types available.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Media array maps IDs to InputMediaPhoto/Video/Audio/Animation/VoiceNote
capabilities.notes: Links: tg://photo?id=, tg://video?id=, tg://audio?id=. Media array resolves IDs to actual media.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for heading type blocks
capabilities.notes: Markdown: # Heading 1 through ###### Heading 6. HTML: <h1>-<h6>.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for paragraph type blocks
capabilities.notes:
HTML:

. Markdown: plain text paragraphs.

limits.language_specification: Yes in blocks/HTML mode, no in standalone HTML <code>

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for pre type blocks
capabilities.fallback: MarkdownV2: indented code or inline code
capabilities.notes: Markdown: ```language\ncode\n```. HTML: <pre><code class="language-x">.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for footer type blocks
capabilities.notes: HTML: <footer>.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for divider type blocks
capabilities.notes: Markdown: ---. HTML: <hr/>.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for anchor type blocks
capabilities.fallback: N/A — anchors not available in MarkdownV2
capabilities.notes: HTML: <a name="...">. Used for in-document navigation.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for list type blocks
capabilities.notes: Supports ordered with type/start/reversed attributes. List items can contain nested blocks.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for list with checkbox items
capabilities.notes: Markdown: - [ ] unchecked, - [x] checked. HTML: <li> with checkbox.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for blockquote type blocks
capabilities.notes: Markdown: > prefix. HTML: <blockquote> with optional <cite>.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for pullquote type blocks
capabilities.notes: HTML: <aside> with optional <cite>. Centered presentation.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for table type blocks
capabilities.notes: Markdown GFM: | header | header |\n| --- | --- |\n| cell | cell |. HTML: <table bordered striped>.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for details type blocks
capabilities.notes: HTML: <details> / <details open> with <summary>. Content can be nested blocks.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for mathematical_expression type blocks
capabilities.notes: Inline: $x^2 + y^2$ or <tg-math>. Block: $$E = mc^2$$ or ```math\nE = mc^2\n``` or <tg-math-block>.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for map type blocks
capabilities.notes: HTML: <tg-map lat="..." long="..." zoom="..."/>. Optional caption.

limits.caption: optional RichBlockCaption
limits.url_scheme: HTTP/HTTPS or tg://photo?id= with media array

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for photo type blocks
capabilities.notes: Markdown: ![](url). HTML: or .

limits.caption: optional RichBlockCaption
limits.url_scheme: HTTP/HTTPS or tg://video?id= with media array

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for video type blocks
capabilities.notes: Markdown: ![](url). HTML: or .

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for animation type blocks
capabilities.notes: HTML: <video> for .gif files. Markdown: ![](animation.gif).

limits.caption: optional RichBlockCaption
limits.url_scheme: HTTP/HTTPS or tg://audio?id= with media array

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for audio type blocks
capabilities.notes: HTML: or .

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for voice_note type blocks
capabilities.notes: HTML: <audio src="...ogg"></audio>. Corresponds to voice note type.

limits.items: Array of media blocks ONLY (photo, video, animation) — not arbitrary blocks
limits.caption: optional RichBlockCaption

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for collage type blocks
capabilities.notes: HTML: <tg-collage>...</tg-collage>. Markdown: consecutive ![](url) blocks. Caption optional. IMPORTANT: collage/slideshow can contain ONLY media blocks (photo/video/animation), not text or other block types.

limits.items: Array of media blocks ONLY (photo, video, animation) — not arbitrary blocks
limits.caption: optional RichBlockCaption

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for slideshow type blocks
capabilities.notes: HTML: <tg-slideshow>...</tg-slideshow>. Markdown: consecutive ![](url) blocks. Caption optional. IMPORTANT: slideshow can contain ONLY media blocks (photo/video/animation), not text or other block types.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Check Message.rich_message.blocks for thinking type blocks
capabilities.notes: Designed for AI streaming use cases. Shows bot is thinking.

limits.requirement: Bot owner has Telegram Premium OR bot purchased username on Fragment

capabilities.verification_strategy: Test send with custom emoji; check if rendered
capabilities.source_reference: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api (RichTextCustomEmoji), Stack Overflow: custom emoji bot requirements
capabilities.notes: Custom emoji entities require Premium owner or Fragment username. Works in private, group, supergroup. Channel support: UNKNOWN — not documented. Do not assume channels support custom emoji from bots.

capabilities.verification_strategy: User mention renders as inline mention in supported clients
capabilities.notes: Markdown: [text](tg://user?id=123456789). HTML: text.

capabilities.verification_strategy: DateTime renders as interactive timestamp in supported clients
capabilities.notes: Markdown: ![](tg://time?unix=1647531900&format=wDT). HTML: <tg-time unix="..." format="...">.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Card numbers detected and formatted automatically
capabilities.notes: Automatically detected in text. Example: card: 4242 4242 4242 4242.

limits.bot_requirement: Bot must be admin or have post permissions

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send to channel; verify Message.rich_message in response
capabilities.notes: chat_id accepts 'username of the target ... channel in the format @username'.

limits.parameter: message_thread_id (forum supergroups and private chats with forum topic mode)

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with message_thread_id; verify in correct topic
capabilities.notes: For forum supergroups and private chats of bots with forum topic mode enabled.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with direct_messages_topic_id; verify in correct DM topic
capabilities.notes: Identifier of the direct messages topic to which the message will be sent.

limits.requirement: Bot can send on behalf of business account only if corresponding user can send rich messages

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with business_connection_id; check response
capabilities.notes: Optional parameter for business connection.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with allow_paid_broadcast=True; check Stars balance
capabilities.fallback: Regular send (rate limited to ~30 msg/sec globally)
capabilities.notes: Optional parameter to bypass broadcasting limits for a fee.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with message_effect_id; check animation in private chat
capabilities.notes: Unique identifier of the message effect to be added to the message.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with reply_markup; check buttons present
capabilities.notes: InlineKeyboardMarkup, ReplyKeyboardMarkup, ReplyKeyboardRemove, ForceReply supported.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with reply_parameters; check message is reply
capabilities.notes: ReplyParameters object. Note: legacy reply_to_message_id scalar also works but is undocumented.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with protect_content=True; check forward/save disabled
capabilities.notes: Protects contents from forwarding and saving.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with disable_notification=True; check no notification
capabilities.notes: Sends message silently. Users receive notification with no sound.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with is_rtl=True; check rendering in RTL language
capabilities.notes: Pass True if rich message must be shown right-to-left.

capabilities.verification_strategy: Send with skip_entity_detection=True; check URLs not auto-linked
capabilities.notes: Skip automatic detection of URLs, emails, username mentions, hashtags, cashtags, bot commands, phone numbers.

limits.usage: inline queries, guest queries, Web App queries

capabilities.verification_strategy: Return InputRichMessageContent from inline query; check rendering
capabilities.notes: Can be used as InputMessageContent in results of inline, guest, and Web App queries.

unsupported_features.notes: Use editMessageText with rich_message parameter instead
No schedule_date parameter in sendRichMessage. Use sendMessage for scheduled messages (different capabilities).
sendRichMessageDraft is private chat only per official documentation
Direct upload of new files not supported in drafts

unsupported_features.capability: New file upload when editing inline rich messages
unsupported_features.notes: When editing inline messages, cannot upload new files — use file_id or URL
Not explicitly documented in official Bot API docs. Custom emoji from bots documented only for private, group, supergroup chats. Do NOT assume channel support — test before relying on this.

text_characters.includes: custom emoji alternative text and formula source

blocks.includes: nested blocks, list items, table rows, quotation blocks, details blocks

table_columns.note: NOT an official Telegram limit. This limit comes from tg-rich-messages library validation. Official Telegram docs do not specify a maximum column count for tables.

for_bot_api_rich_features.note: sendRichMessage, sendRichMessageDraft, editMessageText(rich), all rich block types work via Bot API without Premium

for_custom_emoji.condition: Bot owner has Telegram Premium OR bot purchased username on Fragment

for_user_rendering.note: Telegram clients render rich messages for all users regardless of Premium status

capability_detection.failure: Bad Request or method not found error

media_preserved.note: Media may appear in both rich_message.blocks and standard media fields

fallback_matrix.tables: sendMessage with MarkdownV2 → plain text rows (degraded)
fallback_matrix.headings: sendMessage with MarkdownV2 → # markers visible or bold
fallback_matrix.code_blocks: sendMessage with MarkdownV2 → indented or inline code
fallback_matrix.collapsible_details: sendMessage with MarkdownV2 → no native equivalent
fallback_matrix.math_formulas: sendMessage with MarkdownV2 → raw LaTeX visible
fallback_matrix.pull_quotes: sendMessage with MarkdownV2 → no native equivalent
fallback_matrix.anchors: sendMessage with MarkdownV2 → no native equivalent
fallback_matrix.maps: sendMessage with MarkdownV2 → no native equivalent

use_rich_mode_when: Content contains other structures that degrade poorly through MarkdownV2
use_sendMessage_for: When consistent typography across clients is prioritized

known_issues.notes: Telegram Web may not render sendRichMessage replies correctly. Workaround: disable rich for Web users or use fallback.
Rich Message body text appears larger than normal bot messages, may ignore user's text-size setting.

Rich messages may collapse ordinary line breaks into single paragraph. Mitigation: convert newlines to
.

key_facts: sendRichMessage is REAL and ACUTAL (Bot API 10.1+, June 2026)
Rich document = InputRichMessage with ONE of: html, markdown, or blocks
Media between text via: markdown/html + media array (tg:// links), OR explicit blocks array
Collage = <tg-collage> with media items; Slideshow = <tg-slideshow> with media items
Bot CAN edit rich via editMessageText with rich_message parameter
Proof of saved structure = Message.rich_message field in response
Most rich features work via Bot API without Premium; custom emoji needs Premium owner or Fragment
sendRichMessageDraft is private-chat-only; sendRichMessage works for all chat types
must_implement: Fallback to sendMessage with MarkdownV2/HTML when rich unavailable
may_implement: HTML mode with media array for tg:// resolution
